programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family

Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. Steve says his wife, Monica, punches him and recently pushed him down a flight of stairs. He says he’s not only afraid of her abuse, he’s afraid of how he may retaliate in the heat of anger. The couple has nine children between them – two of whom are severely disabled – and they’re worried about the effect their explosive arguments have on their kids. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Should transgender athletes be allowed to compete with those of the gender they identify with or must they only compete with athletes who share the gender they were assigned at birth? Are laws that ban transgender women from participating in women's sports fair? LGBTQ+ activists have described criteria limiting transgender athlete involvement in gendered sports as "discriminatory.” Lia Thomas made headline news and stirred debate when she competed in swimming nationals as a transgender woman. Dr. Phil, along with Layne Ingram, a transgender man and basketball coach, and Olympic swimmer Nancy Hogshead-Makar, an advocate for girls and women in sports and CEO of Champion Women, discuss what they believe is right and fair. Then, Riley Gaines, who competed against Lia Thomas, gives her perspective on how she felt after their race. The big question is: what does the science say? Harvard professor Dr. Carole Hooven breaks it down.

Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? programme.title: Becoming Evil: Serial Killers
programme.sub-title: The Second Wave: America's Most Notorious Serial Killers
programme.desc: After surviving the Great Depression and World War II, America entered an idyllic age, The Atomic Age, where wholesome values and classic Americana were king. Dads could work in a factory and afford to send his kids to college. Moms could stay at home. And families could afford homes in newly emerging suburbia. Life was home baked chocolate chip cookies. Simple and good. However, 50s America was also a time of heinous crimes. The emerging media of television shined its light on all sorts of cruel and inhuman acts warfare, riots, segregation, and a new awareness psychopathic, serial killers.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Serial Killers
programme.desc: There was a golden age of female serial killers in the U.S. and Europe. Female serial killers that targeted their children, husbands, and other family members. This was a time when women were becoming educated but had very little control over their lives. As a result they had very little recourse or legal remedies if they found themselves in a bad marriage or untenable domestic situation, a solution was to 'free themselves' by poisoning their husbands, or anyone controlling their lives and even killing their children.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Serial Killers

That America, with its large faceless urban centers, street prostitution, poor and neglected inner cities, drug problems, and homelessness, is not only a unique breeding ground for murdering psychopaths but has created a ready-made victim pool for serial killers. Now we know serial killing has no boundaries.

programme.desc: Oakmont isn’t just one of the most historic courses in golf — it’s home to one of the most exclusive clubhouses in American sports. - Ahead of the 125th U.S. Open Championship, we step inside the walls of Oakmont Country Club — a place steeped in U.S. Open history, whispered legends, and decades of golf’s most iconic moments. programme.title: NEW 11/7 - Jimmy Traina Mailbag: YouTubeTV vs. ESPN; Drew Brees and More!
programme.desc: Episode 580 of "SI Media With Jimmy Traina" is an all-Mailbag episode. The show starts off with Jimmy explaining why the podcast was delayed this week and why there isn't a main guest. The "Traina Thoughts" segment featuring Sal Licata from WFAN and SNY follows the intro. Topics covered include the YouTubeTV-ESPN carriage dispute, the passing of NFL broadcaster Bob Trumpy, the Dodgers beating the Blue Jays in Game 7 of the World Series, Sal's interview with actress Sydney Sweeney and more. Following "Traina Thoughts," Jimmy opens up the mailbag. This week, listeners had questions about Fox hiring Drew Brees to essentially replace Mark Sanchez on its No. 3 NFL crew, the performances of Joe Davis and John Smoltz throughout the Major League Baseball postseason, in-game manager interviews, Jimmy's process for writing his daily "Traina Thoughts" column, whether Jimmy hates a couple of New York sports media people, ranking the "Seinfeld" seasons and slicing a bagel.

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: CityLights is a poignant drama that tells the story of Deepak Singh (Rajkummar Rao), a former army man who migrates to Mumbai with his wife and child after losing everything in Rajasthan. Hoping for a better future, he is instead confronted with harsh urban realities—poverty, betrayal, and exploitation. Directed by Hansal Mehta, the film is a deeply emotional exploration of migration, survival, and the human cost of urban dreams. It is a remake of the acclaimed British film Metro Manila.

programme.title: Simmba
programme.desc: Simmba follows the story of Sangram "Simmba" Bhalerao, a corrupt and flamboyant police officer who enjoys the perks of his position until a personal tragedy forces him to rethink his choices. Transforming into a man of justice, Simmba takes on a powerful criminal nexus. With high-octane action, emotional drama, and punchy dialogues, this Rohit Shetty directorial stars Ranveer Singh and Sara Ali Khan in a thrilling narrative of redemption.

programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 2013 floods in Uttarakhand, Kedarnath is an interfaith love story between Mandakini, a wealthy Hindu pilgrim, and Mansoor, a humble Muslim porter who carries her during her journey to the Kedarnath temple. Their growing romance faces opposition from society and family, ultimately tested by nature’s fury. The film blends spiritual, romantic, and disaster elements with emotional depth.

With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors

programme.desc: As the surfers make final preparations to travel to their next WSL World Championship Tour events in France for the Quiksilver & Roxy Pro, they reflect on their 2018 season so far. programme.sub-title: African Renaissance | Brilliant Corners: Senegal, Episode 3
programme.desc: Sam, Easkey, and Adrien catch up with West African surf legend Oumar Seye, the first West African sponsored surfer. Seye has impacted the surf culture in Senegal in more ways than one, both proving the sport can be more than a hobby and supporting sustainability by banning plastic bags at his surf events. They end their trip in Popenguine, a bohemian beach town where an incredible women-led initiative to plant thousands of trees has made the area one of the greenest parts of the country.

programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Lexus US Open of Surfing presented by Pacifico 2025
programme.desc: "It's summer's biggest surf stage." The Lexus US Open of Surfing presented by Pacifico is where the next generation earns their spotlight and where future World Champions are forged. Every heat in Huntington counts. With thousands packing the sand and more looking on from the iconic Huntington Beach pier, it's one of the most electric vibes on the Challenger Series and World Longboard Tours, and the energy jumps off the screen. Watching live = the next best thing to being there.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Tarik Khbabez (52-12-1, 22 KO) and Bahram Rajabzabeh (72-5, 63 KO) collide in a huge showdown for the vacant Light Heavyweight title. The penultimate round of the Last Heavyweight Standing tournament resumes with eight heavyweights competing in two separate four-man one-night tournaments. Notable participants include Levi Rigters (20-3, 10 KO), Nabil Khachab (30-6-1, 4 KO), Rade Opacic (22-7, 17 KO) and Milos Cvjeticanin (14-4, 9 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlining the event is a Light Heavyweight Title Fight between current Champion Sergej Maslobojev and top ranked contender Donegi Abena. A Middleweight Title Bout between Champion Donovan Wisse and current number one contender Cesar Almeida will serve as the event’s co-headliner. Also featured on the card is a middleweight bout between top-five contenders Serkan Ozcaglayan and Sergej Braun. Plus, perennial lightweight contender Guerric Billet will meet Cihad Akipa. GLORY 83 will also mark the promotional debuts for both Uku Jurjendal and Nabil Khachab, who will square off against each other in a heavyweight bout. Additionally, rising featherweight contender Ahmad Chikh Mousa will look to improve his GLORY record to 3-0 in a bout against Berjan Peposhi.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Anaconda Wanted
programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial. Hardly any other animal is so feared and yet at the same time so revered as the biggest snake in the world.

programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: In the first episode of the three-part series, The Biblical Plagues, scholars deal with the first six natural disasters. In the Nile, scientists discovered deadly microorganisms that caused the fish to die and a stress situation among the frog population.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… and the Lord sent thunder and hail, … and fire mingled with the hail,” reports the Old Testament. “And the hail smote … all that was in the field, both man and beast.” (Exodus 9:23–25).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... locusts … invaded all Egypt …. They covered all the ground until it was black,” reports the Bible. “They devoured … everything growing in the fields … – nothing green remained on trees or palms in all the lands of Egypt.” (Exodus 10:14–15). Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… darkness that can be felt … covered all Egypt for three days,” reports the Bible. “No one could see anyone else … for three days.” (Exodus 10:22–23). Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements, threatening the lives of humans and animals alike.

programme.title: Children of the Wild
programme.desc: In many cultures there are myths about “wolf children” who were taken from their families and then grew up in the wild, either alone or with wolves, bears or other animals. But how close are such stories to reality? This program offers a combination of two stories: the true story of the monkey boy John Ssebunya in Uganda, and that of Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli, the most famous, albeit fictitious, wolf child of all. Unlike the children in the myths and stories, children who grow up without human beings have massive problems integrating themselves into society. The program specifically follows the fate of the young Ugandan boy John Ssebunya. If there is no human being as communication partner in the first years of a child’s life, the wolf child will yelp, growl, scream or grunt. He is not yet ready to make contact with other children.

programme.title: In Search of Santa Claus
programme.desc: The amazing transformation of a holy man from Turkey into the world-wide symbol of Christmas cheer. He's one of the most widely recognized figures in the world; but what are the origins of St. Nicholas, and how did he become Santa Claus? With criminological acumen, this one-hour documentary sorts the myths from the facts to present the true story of the first multi-national saint, revered by the Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox churches alike.

programme.title: The Secret of the Phaistos Code
programme.desc: Is the Phaistos Disc a clever fake? The film follows the trail of possibly one of the greatest archaeological scandals ever. The search for the truth starts in the ancient Cretan palace complexes of Phaistos. The North American art dealer Jerome Eisenberg, one of the world’s foremost forgery experts, considers the “Phaistos Disc” to be a latter-day fake. In 1908, it was discovered by the Italian archaeologist Luigi Pernier. Since then, the disc has aroused the scientific ambition of countless linguists. The British academic Gareth Owens has analyzed new archaeological discoveries with unfamiliar characters and believes the disc to be genuine. But Eisenberg remains convinced that the disc cannot be deciphered at all. He claims that not only does it not reveal a text that has ever been decipherable, but also that is not even of ancient origin.

programme.title: The Advance of the Hanseatic League
programme.desc: At the bottom of the Baltic Sea lies a cog, a relic of the might of the German Hanse, a league of merchantmen founded about 1200 AD. Archaeologists are retracing its final voyage using state of the art technology as well as ancient scripts. Their search takes them to the Norwegian port of Bergen, to the Shetlands and even as far as Iceland.

programme.title: Expedition in the South Seas
programme.desc: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life. The film portrays a great natural scientist whose knowledge and legacy determined patterns for scientific research in the 21st century.

programme.title: The Deadly Treasure of Lake Kivu
programme.desc: In Lake Kivu, on the borders of Rwanda and Congo, there is methane gas worth $25 billion. Enough to supply central Africa’s energy needs for generations. But if it explodes, it will kill up to two and a half million people living on Lake Kivu’s shores. The danger is real.

programme.title: In Search of the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: When Jason and his crew of 50 men set sail, a dangerous journey to what was then known as the end of the world lies ahead of the Greek heroes. The young hero had a one-of-a-kind galley built for the voyage, which he baptized "Argo." The mighty rowing boat was designed to take the committed band to the legendary land of Colchis, beyond the Dardanelles.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: For most Europeans, the wolf is more of a myth than an actual wild animal. But since the nineties, Isengrim has been making his way back to the middle of the continent, kilometre by painstaking kilometre. Part One of ‘Wandering Wolves’ follows the renowned biologist Francesca Marucco and other experts on the trail of an Italian nomad wolf on his way to the French Maritime Alps.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe. We see how wolves often cover over a thousand kilometres on their migrations. They swim through fast-flowing rivers and traverse icy mountain ranges and multi-lane motorways.

programme.title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. His destiny is governed by the love of women, and he challenges the most powerful institutions of his time: the Catholic Church and the Venetian Inquisition. For Casanova, life in decadent Venice is an on-going feast for the senses.

programme.title: Missing in Brooks County
programme.desc: Two families search for their loved ones who went missing in the fields of Brooks County, Texas. Directed by Lisa Molomot and Jeff Bemiss.

programme.title: Nuclear Now
programme.desc: With unprecedented access to the nuclear industry in France, Russia, and the United States, filmmaker Oliver Stone explores the possibility for the global community to overcome challenges like climate change and reach a brighter future through the power of nuclear energy- an option that may become a vital way to ensure our continued survival sooner than we think. Directed by Oliver Stone.

programme.title: Caffeinated
programme.desc: Learn the story behind your morning Joe. From seed to mug, coffee, and the process by which it is created, has shaped the lives of thousands of individuals worldwide. Caffeinated gives the coffee consumer unprecedented access to the farmers responsible for growing that perfect bean, and the roasters and baristas responsible for brewing that perfect cup. Directed by Vishal Solanki.

programme.title: After Antarctica
programme.desc: After Antarctica follows legendary polar explorer Will Steger’s journey as an eyewitness to the greatest changes to the polar regions of our planet. Now, thirty years after his historic expedition across the coldest continent on Earth, Steger heads out on the ice once again, at a time when he is not only known for being the first in history to complete these historic feats - he is also the last. Directed by Tasha Van Zandt.

programme.title: Deep Web
programme.desc: The deep web caught the attention of the world with the arrest of Ross William Ulbricht - the convicted entrepreneur accused of being 'Dread Pirate Roberts'. This documentary seeks to unravel the web of secrecy, accusation, and criminal activity surrounding Ulbricht, and also explores how the outcome his trial set a precedent for the future of technological freedom. Directed by Alex Winter.

programme.title: Knuckleball
programme.desc: A documentary that showcases baseball's most unpredictable pitch - follow the journey of the last professional knuckleball pitchers. Tim Wakefield, a 17-year Red Sox veteran, and Mets up-and-comer R.A. Dickey, with just four other living knuckleballers, shine a light on their remarkable brotherhood and the shared pursuit of honor and craftsmanship. Directed by Annie Sundberg.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Uganda
programme.desc: Set in the heart of Uganda, two unlikely friends from opposite sides of the world unite over their shared love of Chuck Norris and gonzo 80’s action flicks. With sheer determination and an outrageous sense of humor, they team up to create their own explosive movies, catapulting Wakaliwood to international stardom and bringing laughter and joy to millions. Directed by Cathryne Czubek.

programme.title: We Could Be King
programme.desc: True story of two rival high school football teams forced to merge into one and their struggle to become champions against all odds. An unflinching snapshot of the power of sports to bring young people, neighborhoods, and a city together. Directed by Judd Ehrlich.

programme.title: A View From The Window
programme.desc: An immersive glimpse of a school day through the eyes of deaf children. Follow a third grade class at the California School for the Deaf in Fremont as they learn about everything from marine life to police harassment. Directed by Christian Filippone and Azar Kafaei.

programme.title: Cherry Pop: The Story Of The World's Fanciest Cat
programme.desc: Cherry Pop was no ordinary cat. Beloved by her wealthy socialite owners, she lived life in the lap of luxury. This delightful story will tickle your funny bone and touch your heart. Directed by Kareem Tabsch.

programme.title: Dolphin Lover
programme.desc: Dolphin Lover is a critically acclaimed, award winning short documentary on the incredible true story of Malcolm Brenner and his summer long love affair with Dolly the dolphin. Directed by Joey Daoud and Kareem Tabsch.

programme.title: Down Again - Censored
programme.desc: DOWN AGAIN is an examination of the connection between mental illness and creativity told through the lens of photographer and Chimaira frontman Mark Hunter, exploring the catharsis of making music and how the art affects the fans.

programme.title: Eleanor Ambos Interiors
programme.desc: As a celebrated interior designer loses her eyesight to macular degeneration, she begins to see her life's work in a new light. This eccentric renegade topples ageist stereotypes as she grapples with the limitations of her aging body. Directed by Katrina Sorrentino and Andrew Ellis.

programme.title: Gotta Groove Records
programme.desc: A short film on the history and resurgence of vinyl records from the perspective of an artist focused pressing plant in Cleveland, Ohio. A hero story about grit, manufacturing and warm tones. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: How To Make A Rainbow
programme.desc: The story of a young girl and her mother, observed over the course of two years, as they move together through transitions of home, identity and name. Directed by Ryan Maxey.

programme.title: Jonah
programme.desc: An interview with a formerly enslaved African American man accompanies a powerful modern day dance vignette. The juxtaposition of past and present raises questions about inherited trauma and the possibility of regeneration. Directed by Andrew Michael Ellis.

programme.title: Muxes
programme.desc: In the southern state of Oaxaca where, in the indigenous communities around the town of Juchitán, the world is not divided simply into males and females. The local Zapotec people have made room for a third category, which they call “muxes” - men who consider themselves women and live in a socially sanctioned limbo between the two genders. Directed by Ivan Olita.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Ode To Desolation
programme.desc: There used to be thousands of fire lookout posts across the US, but now, because of the advancement of satellite technology, there are about 60 left. Jim Henterly holds his post as the eyes and ears of the historic Desolation Peak Fire Lookout - in an effort to preserve the human narrative. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: Life In Miniature
programme.desc: Kath Holden is an artist of the everyday. Inspired by the world around her, Kath's creations are whimsical yet keenly observed, and a far cry from the genteel museum pieces that her contemporaries are producing. A proud Yorkshire woman, Kath reflects on her life and art as she carves a place for herself in the precious world of miniatures. Directed by Ellen Evans.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Theories usually have a basis in some traditional thought process. This episode looks at a few common theories and how to use them in modern quilting. Stephanie Skardal discusses color theory. She begins with a color wheel of fabric and talks history and color schemes using basic color theory. Then, Lee Chappell Monroe shows how to make a plan to use pressing for a professional finish. Eliane Bergmann demonstrates various ways to mark your fabric in the machine tip.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Say hello to The Midnight Quilt Show, a series that celebrates late-night stitches, taking shortcuts and sewing in your PJs! Each week, host Angela Walters will bring you a quick and quippy breakdown of a brand new quilt… wine not included.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: With a little creativity, clothing becomes convertible. Designer Laura Pifer rescues a men's shirt and adds ribbing and a zipper to create a trendy bomber jacket. Fashion expert Angela Wolf adds cuffs to the denim shirt dress. Then, she creates a cozy sweater jacket from a giant square of fabric.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Babies and children are a great inspiration to sew. Couture fashion expert Angela Wolf transforms a simple t-shirt into a super cute girl's dress. Then, she shows how to make spaghetti straps quickly. Pattern designer Krista Tracy makes a trendy waterproof backpack to use as a diaper bag or a pool or gym bag.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Stacking bracelets are today's hottest style statement. Jewelry designer Meredith Roddy creates three distinct styles of stacking bracelets to combine or to wear alone. Candie Cooper designs trendy earrings for teens and tweens in Katie's Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Your home is a gallery for your art. Artist Dina Wakley makes a wall hanging with tissue stamping. Tool expert Joe Rotella uses computer design and cutting technology to create an apron. Using watercolors, calligrapher Janet Takahashi creates simple brush lettering. Author Rebekah Meier has a tip for adding a splash of color to any home.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Raid your art box for paint and gesso as we paint our way to fantastic layouts. Create Stencils with Jenny Barnett Rohrs, a layout from Ronda Palazzari with a technique for changing patterned paper into unique embellishments with gesso, and watercolors, and the fourth level (that's more than the third!) of dimension from Kim Hupke on a page entitled "my girl".

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: From basic blocks, great new art is built. Lynn Suprock uses a blender to turn recycled materials into paper. Rebekah Meier cuts, sews and paints a multi-media collage. Mary Hettsmansperger makes cold connection jewelry and Jane Dunnewald shares more ideas on alignment.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels

programme.desc: Pump up your personal style statement. Host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer draws and cuts custom screens for silkscreen printing. programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore the Bauhaus Legacy in Dessau, Germany. The Bauhaus is the 20th century’s most influential art, architecture, and design school that inspired a mindset and style known as Modernism. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she visits iconic Bauhaus Buildings earning Dessau a UNESCO World Heritage Site designation. The industrial city in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt holds the world’s largest collection of Bauhaus buildings. Much of the city’s Bauhaus architecture traces back to The Bauhaus School, which relocated to Dessau from Weimar in 1925.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore Erfurt, the capital city of the German state of Thuringia. During medieval times, a major trade route ran through Erfurt, shaping its history, culture and commerce. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she shops the Merchant’s Bridge, the city’s iconic covered bridge lined with the workshops of craftspeople, preserving time-honored traditions that connect to the past with a present-day appreciation of objects made with meaning, passion, and patience. Germany is the birthplace of the Bauhaus a revolutionary school of art, architecture, and design that thrived in the 1920s and 30s, becoming the trailblazer for present-day modernism. The influence of the Bauhaus is worldwide, including right here in Erfurt, reflected in the many handicrafts for sale.

programme.desc: In this episode of The Design Tourist, travel journalist Karen LeBlanc explores Iceland off the beaten path, away from the country's famously crowded tourist attractions. Join Karen as she heads west to explore the country's geological wonders, from lava caves and glaciers to volcano-heated baths. Learn why Husafell is the ideal location for spotting the Northern Lights and experiencing Iceland's culinary culture.

programme.sub-title: Valencia, Spain: Where the Silk Road Leads to a World Design Capital
programme.desc: Valencia, Spain has many claims to fame: the birthplace of paella, the growers of Valencia oranges, the cradle of ceramics production, a World Design Capital, and the 2024 European Green Capital. programme.desc: Join travel journalist Karen LeBlanc, The Design Tourist, as she explores the authentic soul of Cuba—from vintage cars and Hemingway’s haunts to Havana’s thriving art scene and Santeria rituals. Journey from Havana’s historic plazas to countryside traditions, discovering the people, passions, and places reshaping the island today. Learn how Cuba's cultural quirks, resilient spirit, and emerging creative class are redefining life post-revolution. Whether you're curious about Cuban cuisine, UNESCO heritage sites, or modern entrepreneurialism, this immersive travel story reveals it all.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio4: El lujo de un par de perros con todo
programme.desc: Luís Fernando le comenta a santiago que Maria fue muy especial para él y que piensa ir a su casa y llevarle flores de sorpresa. No se imagina que Maria no vive allí. Dileidy le asegura a Yennilú que su novio sabe del paradero de ella, pero Yennilú le precisa que le cuente realmente lo que pasó. Luego en la vía se aparece Luís Fernando quien va en su carro con Santiago y se para enfrente donde está Dileidy y Yenilú, Dileidy se esconde para que él no la vea, él le dice a Dileidy que se voltee porque necesita un periódico de ayer, por momentos Dileidy cree morir, Yenilú lo distrae y Luís Fernando le dice que allí está reseñada su novia quien salió bellísima, Dileidy oye esto a espaldas de él y le da sin voltear el periódico que él necesita, luego se van los dos sin sospechar que quien le dio ese periódico es su Maria., Luís Fernando tampoco sospecha la actitud extraña de la pregonera. A la oficina llega una nueva ingeniero en sustitución de Matilde, todos quedan embelesados por ella. Egleé por momentos piensa si ella será la tambaleadota de matrimonios, desearía que Rómulo la dejara por ella. Matilde se esfuerza en su casa limpiando y cocinando para Gonzalo y éste le hace un desaire además de decirle que alguien la sustituyó en la oficina, Matilde le dice que está harta y que no moverá más un dedo en la casa. Tatianita le comenta a Felicita que Luís Fernando estuvo toda la noche bailando y conversando con una chica. Felicita enfurece por no haber ido entonces a la fiesta con él. Tatianita la insta a que termine con él y esto es lo que decide Felicita entonces. La nena, Pascuita, Egleé, Matilde y Rosita conversan que con los niños no queda tiempo para mimar a los maridos. Egleé comenta que su matrimonio es aburrido, La Nena piensa que se siente muy sola, Pascuita piensa que debe cuidar mucho a su marido y rosita piensa que los maridos no saben cómo hacer feliz a una la mujer, y que los hijos son de la mujer. Dileidy le comenta a Yennilú que Luís Fernando anda es enamorado de la Maria que ella le inventó no de la pregonera que vive en un barrio como en realidad es., Dileidy dice que metió la pata que él no la puede querer como ella es en realidad porque eso no existe. Felicita le dice a su madre que terminará con Luís Fernando. Egleé le dice a cristinita que si le insinúa algo a Gladis de que ella ha robado su vestido y se le va que la emplea de cachifa en casa de Pascuita. Dileidy cae en cuenta de que al vestido le falta un prendedor, Gladis se asusta y se revela diciendo que Egleé se dar á cuenta que tomó el vestido, Dileidy le reclama entonces por qué tuvo que haberlo hecho. Dileidy sin darse cuenta dice que lo debe haber dejado en el carro de su novio, Gladis asombrada entonces le pregunta qué novio es ese. Luego cada una convence ala otra de que no tomó el vestido y de que no tiene novio dileidy. Luís Fernando encuentra el prendedor extraviado de Dileidy en su carro y ahora ve una perfecta excusa para irla a visitar a su supuesta casa. Dileidy le comenta a su madre que en la fiesta no conoció a un novio sino a un grupo de gente y se comportó como si fuera de su clase y les mintió y no les dijo que era pregonera ni nada de eso.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio5: La novia de Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Dileidy le promete a su madre que se inscribirá en la universidad porque ella se lo merece. Al regreso a su casa pasa por donde Luís Fernando cree que vive ella, su madre insiste en que cuánto costaría allí un pent house y le dice que quiere preguntarle a la conserje en eso casualmente ve parado a Luís Fernando justo frente al edificio con un ramo de flores luego convence a su mamá de marcharse de allí y que tome un autobús cosa que hace Gladis pero Dileidy se queda y se devuelve hasta el edificio y sorprende a Luís Fernando y lo saluda. Dileidy por momentos le dice la ruta que tiene que hacer para ir para su casa pero Luís Fernando piensa que es broma de ella. Dileidy lo persuade para que él no sospeche nada de que ella no vive allí y le dice que se vayan para otra parte. Él acepta entonces. Luís Fernando piensa que Dileidy vende periódicos pero en ventas en Mercadeo. Luís Fernando le plantea a Dileidy que si quiere trabajar a futuro con él como ingeniero en la ciudad que piensa proyectar. Luego Luisfi la lleva al supuesto edificio donde ella vive, ella le pregunta si él tiene novia. Pascuita le aconseja a Felicita que luche por su amor y se le presente a Luís Fernando como si nada. Luís Fernando habla con su abuelo de qué hacer con Dileidy si se le presenta con el ramo y el prendedor o con una de las cosas. Su abuelo le dice que ella lo ha dejado enganchado. La nena le reclama a su hija que no quiere saber del tema de Luís Fernando y que ahora estará a pie porque no puede renovarle la póliza al carro. Tatianita enfurece y le dice que se busque un marido. La nena enfurece y le dice que ni muerta se busca un marido para que la mantenga. Doroteo le comenta a Gabriel que lo botaron del trabajo y que piensa en conseguirse una mujer que lo mantenga. Rómulo le reclama a Egleé en una comida que comparten con los suegros de él que tiene veinte años comiendo el pollo de la misma forma., José por su parte le dice que no le reclama a Rosita el mojito que tanto ha hecho pero que a él no le gusta. Matilde molesta porque su marido no la ayuda a cuidar a los morochos, pero Gonzalo más bien piensa que Matilde lo que quiere es buscar una hembrita. Ambos dos no se comunican lo que les inquieta y cuando Gonzalo le dice que quiere que tengan una hembrita Matilde lo echa furica del cuarto. Gonzalo no entiende el por qué. Cristinita le dice a Felicita que la sirvienta de su casa le robó el vestido a la cuaima de la foto del periódico., luego le dice que no que no es su vestido pero felicita no le cree y le dice que averiguará todo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio6: La novia universitaria de Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Luís Fernando ante la pregunta que le hace Dileidy si tiene novia él reacciona con sorpresa pero le dice que la única novia que tiene es ella. En el periódico sale una noticia de que los científicos comprobaron que el amor sólo dura dos años, rosita y José no comparten esa opinión; Egleé sí lo comparte. Egleé le dice a Luís Fernando que lo estuvo esperando Felicita, Egleé le reclama que cuándo se va a enseriar que va a perder a su amiga Pascuita por felicita., Luís Fernando le dice que con la mujer con la que ahora sale sí se va a quedar y no se meterá más con las hijas de sus amigas. Dileidy llega a su casa sin el ramo que le regaló Luisfi y Gladis le pregunta dónde y con quien estuvo, ella le miente diciéndole que estuvo con un grupo en un lugar en el este que le ofreció hasta trabajo. Gladis no se come mucho el cuento. Luego Dileidy cuando está sola busca el ramo. Dileidy le comenta a su amiga Yennilú que su novio le dijo que ella era su única novia y que ella le cree sin imaginarse que es Felicita realmente. Felicita se le presenta a Luisfi a su trabajo, él le dice que ha estado ocupado. Luís Fernando espera que ella termine con él pero aunque ella está molesta prefiere no hacérselo saber a él para que no la deje. Ella le dice que no le importa y le pregunta cómo le quedaron sus senos operados. Llega el día Dileidy va con su madre a inscribirse en la universidad, Gladis se encuentra a una antigua amiga de liceo y la admira pues es profesora de allí y bien vestida., luego Gladis se encuentra a Luís Fernando quien busca a Dileidy sin imaginar que está allí su madre., ambos se dicen que acompañan a alguien a inscribirse. Gladis le pregunta si está enamorando de una universitaria sin imaginar que se trata de su hija. Luego se despiden y Luís Fernando sorprende a Dileidy, ésta última ríe nerviosa porque su madre no puede verla con él allí, se mete luego con Luís Fernando en un salón donde dan clases y se sale por un momento le dice a su madre que la espere en el cafetín mientras habla con Luís Fernando. Luego al irse su madre se besa con Luís Fernando. Doroteo en el supermercado trata de convencer al empleador de que le dé empleo como pasillero, en el mismo lugar está La Nena lamentándose de no tener mucho dinero. Marco y Egleé ven a Pascuita vigilando a Ramón, Egleé piensa que ella no haría eso por Rómulo, Marco le dice que el amor parece que es así porque les va muy bien. Felicita le comenta a Tatianita que no dejará a Luís Fernando, Alegría le advierte a su hermana que no le diga a tatianita sus estrategias para no dejarse quitar a Luís Fernando porque tatianita obviamente le quiere quitar a Luís Fernando. Marco le reclama a Egleé que debería tenerle a él más confianza, Egleé le dice que no es eso sino que ella no sabe lo que a ella misma le pasa y tampoco quiere averiguarlo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy se besa con Luís Fernando en los pasillos de la universidad cuando de pronto ella ve a su madre se aleja rápidamente de él, Gladis lo saluda sin imaginar con quien estaba él, luego se va y le dice que esta buscando a su hija, él le dice que anda en las mismas buscando a su novia. Luego ella se va y Dileidy se le acerca, él le pregunta que ahora qué ocurre ella nerviosa le miente diciéndole que es nuevo para ella el lugar y su nueva condición y “le da pena” estarse besando así en un sitio así. Luego acuerdan en verse en la noche y Dileidy luego aborda a solas a su madre. Ésta le cuenta que se encontró al hijo de la señora Gladis, y anda molesta porque en el fondo ella teme algo entre ellos dos. Gladis le cuenta a su hija que el hijo de la señora Egleé tiene a su novia oficial y otra que estudia en la universidad y que es un mujeriego. Dileidy le dice que si le pasara eso a ella ella no lo aguantaría. Cristinita ve el prendedor suyo en el cuarto de su hermano. Ella piensa que Luís Fernando le robó entonces el vestido a ella para prestárselo a la supuesta novia con la que salió en el periódico. Doroteo y La Nena se conocen coincidencialmente en el banco, ella formando lío porque le bloquearon su tarjeta y él buscando trabajo como cajero. Egleé aburrida acompaña a Rómulo a un sitio para que él compre un CD que le gusta mucho. Ella lo espera en la avenida y perdida en sus pensamientos no se da cuenta que un minibús casi la atropella. Luís Fernando se dispone a salir a buscar a Dileidy para su salida por la noche cuando se le presenta a él felicita con su madre con una torta para compartir las dos familias. Luís Fernando llama a Dileidy y le dice que tiene un compromiso familiar que no puede faltar. Dileidy entonces se queda embarcada y le dice mintiéndole que ella ique anda con un grupo celebrando que va a entrar a la universidad. Dileidy se devuelve para su casa y a su regreso alguien la sigue, al llegar al barrio aún el hombre la seguía y cuál es su sorpresa que se trataba del hijo de Gabriel Aureliano, Dileidy se sorprende cuando la sigue hasta la bodega de él. Aureliano le dice que la dejaron plantada delante de Gabriel y Doroteo, dileidy lo niega. Gladis le da dinero a Yuraima para que vaya al cine con Gerson y ve a Gladis de donde saca sus ahorros. Rómulo le cuenta a Pascuita y a Ramón lo que para él le parece cómico que a Egleé la pudieron haber atropellado en la calle. Egleé piensa que tiene que hacer un cambio en su vida porque no puede seguir tan aburrida. Gonzalo habla con sus padres sobre lo de que Matilde quiere meter a los niños en la guardería. José le dice que su madre es su madre y su esposa es otra cosa. Rosita por su parte le dice que a su matrimonio le hace falta alegría. Dileidy se encuentra en su vía vendiendo periódico sin darse cuenta que cerca tiene a Luís Fernando, ambos dos pensando cada uno en el otro, de repente Luís Fernando la llama sin sospechar que la tiene al lado parada, ella atiende y él le contesta pero él se extraña de que justo cuando llama repica y oye la voz de su Maria; Dileidy se da cuenta del lío en que está pero Yennilú persuade a un policía para que persuada a Luís Fernando y le dic que está multado. Este hecho distrae a Luís Fernando aunque queda sorprendido que la pregonera la cual vio de espaldas haya contestado el teléfono justo cuando él llamaba. Felicita le pregunta a Gladis en donde más trabaja ella, Gladis le dice entonces Felicita llega a la conclusión de que Luís Fernando fue el que le robó el vestido a su hermana para prestárselo a su novia que salió en prensa. Matilde precisa a Gonzalo y conversa con él y le dice que ella desea por sus meritos que tuvo en la universidad y los sacrificios que tuvo que hacer para cuidar a los niños que merece trabajar aunque sea medio tiempo y dejar a los niños en una guardería. Dileidy le comenta a Yennilú que ya no quiere pasar más sustos con Luís Fernando y que le va a decir la verdad de su vida.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio8: Salga sapo o salga rana, se lo digo manana
programme.desc: Dileidy le dice a Yennilú que piensa decirle la verdad de su real vida a Luís Fernando. Luís Fernando por su parte le dice a Santiago que piensa dejar a Felicita. Gladis le dice a Matilde que los hombres no escuchan a sus mujeres sino las tres primeras frases que lo demás lo olvidan. Cristinita le muestra a su mamá el prendedor que estaba en su vestido. Egleé obvia su comentario y más bien le dice que ella se casó muy joven y que no sabía qué estudiar pero lo que sí sabe es que no quería que su vida actual fuera así. Pascuita le dice a su hija que haga como ella echarle para atrás todos los planes de amoríos con otras mujeres a ramón, que si quiere que su matrimonio funcione tiene que seguirle los pasos a su Luisfi y ver qué hace. Egleé conversando con su madre, Pascuita, Matilde y La Nena concluye que ella quiere darle un cambio radical a su vida., luego dice que quiere cambiar su marido pero apenada luego les dice a todas que lo decía en broma. Luisfi se alista para su cita con Dileidy en parque del este y en eso llega felicita. Luís Fernando la logra evadir y va a su encuentro con Dileidy, Dileidy ensaya para decirle a él su verdad pero él la halaga con palabras bonitas y Dileidy no le dice nada a él entonces. Yuraima le dice a Gerson que Gladis podría tener dinero. Gladis y Gabriel planean hacerle un festejo a Dileidy por ser ahora universitaria. Luís Fernando le dice a su madre que tenia una fiesta donde rea una reunión familiar y él todavía no pertenencia a esa familia. Egleé ese sorprende que él quiera pertenecer a esa familia de esa muchacha que le gusta. Doroteo va a un empleo donde solicitan sushero y coincidencialmente está La Nena con su hija, cuando van de salida al igual que Doroteo éste le abre la puerta del recinto para que salgan, a La Nena al igual que a Doroteo se sorprenden verse los dos nuevamente. Dileidy le confirma a su madre que sabia que la fiesta era sorpresa, Gladis le pregunta por qué no trajo al grupo que supuestamente le va a dar trabajo, Gladis le pregunta si le daba pena que esa gente conociera donde vive, Gladis le dice que si al sifrinito ese que ella conoce le da vergüenza donde ella vive que a ella futura ingeniera hija de una sirvienta debe andar con su cabeza bien en alto. Egleé le dice a Luís Fernando que termine de una buena vez con Felicita si le gusta otra mujer. Doroteo le comenta a Gabriel de su mala suerte porque no lo contrataron en el puesto de sushero que quería. Gonzalo y Matilde atendiendo a los morochos posponen la conversación que tienen pendiente. Egleé quiere hablarle muy sinceramente a Rómulo acerca de su fastidio en su matrimonio y encuentra a Rómulo dormido. Gerson le pide a Yuraima guindar en la sala el vestido que Gladis tiene que devolverle a Egleé. Yuraima le pregunta a Gerson si habló con su madre del dinero que le prestara pero Gerson le dice que luego habla eso con ella. Dileidy tiene el firme propósito de decirle a Luís Fernando que es pobre, Luís Fernando por su parte tiene el firme propósito de terminar con Felicita., cuando llega el momento de que él le diga a Felicita ésta lo persuade de que le diga lo que le quiere decir en una cafetería. Él la lleva y en el camino se detiene en el semáforo donde trabaja dileidy, dileidy lo ve que anda acompañado de Felicita cuando Felicita le da un beso a Luís Fernando dentro del carro. Gladis ve que Felicita amaducha a Luís Fernando al llegar a casa de éste, cuando Luís Fernando planea dejar a felicita. Gladis se horroriza al ver que anda con Felicita y a la vez con una universitaria sin imaginar que es su hija a la que también enamora. Cristinita le pregunta a Gladis delante de sus padres dónde está su vestido de fiesta.

programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio4: El lujo de un par de perros con todo
programme.desc: Luís Fernando le comenta a santiago que Maria fue muy especial para él y que piensa ir a su casa y llevarle flores de sorpresa. No se imagina que Maria no vive allí. Dileidy le asegura a Yennilú que su novio sabe del paradero de ella, pero Yennilú le precisa que le cuente realmente lo que pasó. Luego en la vía se aparece Luís Fernando quien va en su carro con Santiago y se para enfrente donde está Dileidy y Yenilú, Dileidy se esconde para que él no la vea, él le dice a Dileidy que se voltee porque necesita un periódico de ayer, por momentos Dileidy cree morir, Yenilú lo distrae y Luís Fernando le dice que allí está reseñada su novia quien salió bellísima, Dileidy oye esto a espaldas de él y le da sin voltear el periódico que él necesita, luego se van los dos sin sospechar que quien le dio ese periódico es su Maria., Luís Fernando tampoco sospecha la actitud extraña de la pregonera. A la oficina llega una nueva ingeniero en sustitución de Matilde, todos quedan embelesados por ella. Egleé por momentos piensa si ella será la tambaleadota de matrimonios, desearía que Rómulo la dejara por ella. Matilde se esfuerza en su casa limpiando y cocinando para Gonzalo y éste le hace un desaire además de decirle que alguien la sustituyó en la oficina, Matilde le dice que está harta y que no moverá más un dedo en la casa. Tatianita le comenta a Felicita que Luís Fernando estuvo toda la noche bailando y conversando con una chica. Felicita enfurece por no haber ido entonces a la fiesta con él. Tatianita la insta a que termine con él y esto es lo que decide Felicita entonces. La nena, Pascuita, Egleé, Matilde y Rosita conversan que con los niños no queda tiempo para mimar a los maridos. Egleé comenta que su matrimonio es aburrido, La Nena piensa que se siente muy sola, Pascuita piensa que debe cuidar mucho a su marido y rosita piensa que los maridos no saben cómo hacer feliz a una la mujer, y que los hijos son de la mujer. Dileidy le comenta a Yennilú que Luís Fernando anda es enamorado de la Maria que ella le inventó no de la pregonera que vive en un barrio como en realidad es., Dileidy dice que metió la pata que él no la puede querer como ella es en realidad porque eso no existe. Felicita le dice a su madre que terminará con Luís Fernando. Egleé le dice a cristinita que si le insinúa algo a Gladis de que ella ha robado su vestido y se le va que la emplea de cachifa en casa de Pascuita. Dileidy cae en cuenta de que al vestido le falta un prendedor, Gladis se asusta y se revela diciendo que Egleé se dar á cuenta que tomó el vestido, Dileidy le reclama entonces por qué tuvo que haberlo hecho. Dileidy sin darse cuenta dice que lo debe haber dejado en el carro de su novio, Gladis asombrada entonces le pregunta qué novio es ese. Luego cada una convence ala otra de que no tomó el vestido y de que no tiene novio dileidy. Luís Fernando encuentra el prendedor extraviado de Dileidy en su carro y ahora ve una perfecta excusa para irla a visitar a su supuesta casa. Dileidy le comenta a su madre que en la fiesta no conoció a un novio sino a un grupo de gente y se comportó como si fuera de su clase y les mintió y no les dijo que era pregonera ni nada de eso.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio5: La novia de Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Dileidy le promete a su madre que se inscribirá en la universidad porque ella se lo merece. Al regreso a su casa pasa por donde Luís Fernando cree que vive ella, su madre insiste en que cuánto costaría allí un pent house y le dice que quiere preguntarle a la conserje en eso casualmente ve parado a Luís Fernando justo frente al edificio con un ramo de flores luego convence a su mamá de marcharse de allí y que tome un autobús cosa que hace Gladis pero Dileidy se queda y se devuelve hasta el edificio y sorprende a Luís Fernando y lo saluda. Dileidy por momentos le dice la ruta que tiene que hacer para ir para su casa pero Luís Fernando piensa que es broma de ella. Dileidy lo persuade para que él no sospeche nada de que ella no vive allí y le dice que se vayan para otra parte. Él acepta entonces. Luís Fernando piensa que Dileidy vende periódicos pero en ventas en Mercadeo. Luís Fernando le plantea a Dileidy que si quiere trabajar a futuro con él como ingeniero en la ciudad que piensa proyectar. Luego Luisfi la lleva al supuesto edificio donde ella vive, ella le pregunta si él tiene novia. Pascuita le aconseja a Felicita que luche por su amor y se le presente a Luís Fernando como si nada. Luís Fernando habla con su abuelo de qué hacer con Dileidy si se le presenta con el ramo y el prendedor o con una de las cosas. Su abuelo le dice que ella lo ha dejado enganchado. La nena le reclama a su hija que no quiere saber del tema de Luís Fernando y que ahora estará a pie porque no puede renovarle la póliza al carro. Tatianita enfurece y le dice que se busque un marido. La nena enfurece y le dice que ni muerta se busca un marido para que la mantenga. Doroteo le comenta a Gabriel que lo botaron del trabajo y que piensa en conseguirse una mujer que lo mantenga. Rómulo le reclama a Egleé en una comida que comparten con los suegros de él que tiene veinte años comiendo el pollo de la misma forma., José por su parte le dice que no le reclama a Rosita el mojito que tanto ha hecho pero que a él no le gusta. Matilde molesta porque su marido no la ayuda a cuidar a los morochos, pero Gonzalo más bien piensa que Matilde lo que quiere es buscar una hembrita. Ambos dos no se comunican lo que les inquieta y cuando Gonzalo le dice que quiere que tengan una hembrita Matilde lo echa furica del cuarto. Gonzalo no entiende el por qué. Cristinita le dice a Felicita que la sirvienta de su casa le robó el vestido a la cuaima de la foto del periódico., luego le dice que no que no es su vestido pero felicita no le cree y le dice que averiguará todo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio6: La novia universitaria de Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Luís Fernando ante la pregunta que le hace Dileidy si tiene novia él reacciona con sorpresa pero le dice que la única novia que tiene es ella. En el periódico sale una noticia de que los científicos comprobaron que el amor sólo dura dos años, rosita y José no comparten esa opinión; Egleé sí lo comparte. Egleé le dice a Luís Fernando que lo estuvo esperando Felicita, Egleé le reclama que cuándo se va a enseriar que va a perder a su amiga Pascuita por felicita., Luís Fernando le dice que con la mujer con la que ahora sale sí se va a quedar y no se meterá más con las hijas de sus amigas. Dileidy llega a su casa sin el ramo que le regaló Luisfi y Gladis le pregunta dónde y con quien estuvo, ella le miente diciéndole que estuvo con un grupo en un lugar en el este que le ofreció hasta trabajo. Gladis no se come mucho el cuento. Luego Dileidy cuando está sola busca el ramo. Dileidy le comenta a su amiga Yennilú que su novio le dijo que ella era su única novia y que ella le cree sin imaginarse que es Felicita realmente. Felicita se le presenta a Luisfi a su trabajo, él le dice que ha estado ocupado. Luís Fernando espera que ella termine con él pero aunque ella está molesta prefiere no hacérselo saber a él para que no la deje. Ella le dice que no le importa y le pregunta cómo le quedaron sus senos operados. Llega el día Dileidy va con su madre a inscribirse en la universidad, Gladis se encuentra a una antigua amiga de liceo y la admira pues es profesora de allí y bien vestida., luego Gladis se encuentra a Luís Fernando quien busca a Dileidy sin imaginar que está allí su madre., ambos se dicen que acompañan a alguien a inscribirse. Gladis le pregunta si está enamorando de una universitaria sin imaginar que se trata de su hija. Luego se despiden y Luís Fernando sorprende a Dileidy, ésta última ríe nerviosa porque su madre no puede verla con él allí, se mete luego con Luís Fernando en un salón donde dan clases y se sale por un momento le dice a su madre que la espere en el cafetín mientras habla con Luís Fernando. Luego al irse su madre se besa con Luís Fernando. Doroteo en el supermercado trata de convencer al empleador de que le dé empleo como pasillero, en el mismo lugar está La Nena lamentándose de no tener mucho dinero. Marco y Egleé ven a Pascuita vigilando a Ramón, Egleé piensa que ella no haría eso por Rómulo, Marco le dice que el amor parece que es así porque les va muy bien. Felicita le comenta a Tatianita que no dejará a Luís Fernando, Alegría le advierte a su hermana que no le diga a tatianita sus estrategias para no dejarse quitar a Luís Fernando porque tatianita obviamente le quiere quitar a Luís Fernando. Marco le reclama a Egleé que debería tenerle a él más confianza, Egleé le dice que no es eso sino que ella no sabe lo que a ella misma le pasa y tampoco quiere averiguarlo.

programme.desc: Dileidy se besa con Luís Fernando en los pasillos de la universidad cuando de pronto ella ve a su madre se aleja rápidamente de él, Gladis lo saluda sin imaginar con quien estaba él, luego se va y le dice que esta buscando a su hija, él le dice que anda en las mismas buscando a su novia. Luego ella se va y Dileidy se le acerca, él le pregunta que ahora qué ocurre ella nerviosa le miente diciéndole que es nuevo para ella el lugar y su nueva condición y “le da pena” estarse besando así en un sitio así. Luego acuerdan en verse en la noche y Dileidy luego aborda a solas a su madre. Ella piensa que Luís Fernando le robó entonces el vestido a ella para prestárselo a la supuesta novia con la que salió en el periódico.
